title: Travel vaccines
what: The doctor chooses vaccines for the country you are going to. Some countries require a vaccine to enter.
why: Before travel to tropical and other countries with diseases that are rare at home.
duration: the consultation usually takes 20 to 40 minutes, and a shot a few seconds; come 4 to 8 weeks before your trip
tell_doctor: Where you are going, when, and for how long
How you will stay: city, countryside, hiking
What vaccines you have already had

prepare.title: Plan ahead
prepare.text: Come 1 to 2 months before your trip. Some vaccines need time to work, and some need several shots.

prepare.title: Requirements
prepare.text: Check the country's entry rules. Sometimes a vaccination certificate is required.

steps: The doctor asks about your trip and your health
The needed vaccines and schedule are chosen
You get one shot, or several on the same day
You get advice on staying healthy on the trip
feel: Sometimes a sore arm for 1 to 2 days, tiredness, or a fever
after: Stay near the room for 30 minutes
Take the certificate with you on the trip
If another dose is needed, do not miss it before you leave
red_flags: Trouble breathing, swelling of the face or throat, or a rash all over: call emergency services
A fever and feeling unwell after your trip: tell your doctor where you have been

faq.q: Can I get vaccines a week before my trip?
faq.a: Some, yes, but protection may not have time to build fully. It is better to come early.

faq.q: Where is the yellow fever vaccine needed?
faq.a: In a number of countries in Africa and South America. Check the country's rules and ask your doctor.

reminders.text: Travel vaccine consultation in 2 days. Bring your passport and vaccination certificate.
